profile.about: I build payments infrastructure that people don't have to think about. Today I lead the platform team at Northwind Systems, where we moved billing off a monolith and took p99 checkout latency from 1.8s to 340ms across 12 million monthly transactions. Before that I spent three years on data ingestion at Cartograph, scaling a Go pipeline from 8K to 95K events per second. I care most about the unglamorous parts — failover you can prove works, observability that catches the incident before the customer does, and migrations that finish. I mentor four engineers and write about distributed systems tradeoffs when I have something worth saying.
